children: Parker-Hannifin priced $2.4B of U.S. notes and €2.025B of Euro notes to repay acquisition-related term loan.
Proceeds, together with cash, are intended to repay borrowings under the 364-day term loan tied to the Filtration Group acquisition.
Both offerings registered on Form S-3; expected to close on or about September 14, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
